title: Only the author edits; delete needs authorship or that record's Delete
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (the standard Admin role). This is User A.
  2. A work order at this location: Work Orders -> New Work Order, select a customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair"), save.
  3. A part sale at this location: Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, select the customer.
  4. The customer's own notes: Customers -> open the customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") -> Notes tab.
  5. To write a note on any of these records: on its Notes tab click New Note, type the message, type @ and pick the person, then save.
  6. As User A, write one note on each: the work order, the part sale and the customer.
  7. A teammate at the same location to tag, User B (e.g. "Dana Lee"); they are listed under Settings -> Staff. Create the test role: Settings -> Roles & Permissions -> Create custom role -> choose a template (e.g. "Service Advisor") -> Apply; tick Work Orders -> Delete, and untick Part Sales -> Delete and Customers -> Delete; enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST WO delete" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> open User B -> Edit Staff Member -> Role -> pick "ZZAUTOTEST WO delete" -> save. User B must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session).
  8. A second teammate, User C (e.g. "Sam Ortiz"). Create the test role: Settings -> Roles & Permissions -> Create custom role -> choose a template (e.g. "Service Advisor") -> Apply; tick Part Sales -> Delete and Customers -> Delete, and untick Work Orders -> Delete; enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST PS and customer delete" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> open User C -> Edit Staff Member -> Role -> pick "ZZAUTOTEST PS and customer delete" -> save. User C must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session).
  9. A teammate with neither role and none of those Delete permissions, User D (e.g. a Technician).
  10. For the last step: a work order note written by the customer in the Customer Portal, and a system note (one the app wrote itself). If the work order has neither, mark step 5 Blocked and write why.
custom_steps:
1. As User A (the author), edit your work order note and add then remove an attachment.
  2. Sign in as User D and look at User A's notes for edit and delete.
  3. Sign in as User B and look for delete on the work order note, the part sale note and the customer note.
  4. Sign in as User C and look for delete on the same three notes.
  5. As User A, open the customer's portal note and the system note and look for their ⋮ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Only the author can edit a note or add and remove its attachments; User D is offered neither edit nor delete.
  • User B (Work Orders -> Delete) is offered delete on the work order note only, not on the part sale or customer note.
  • User C (Part Sales -> Delete, Customers -> Delete) is offered delete on the part sale note and the customer note, not on the work order note.
  • A note written by a customer in the portal, and a system note, have no ⋮ menu and cannot be deleted from the app, even by an admin.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10253 (S10, Who can do what); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297) as edited 2 October 2026, S10; read 5 Oct 2026. Source-verified 5 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R5: “Only the note's author can edit a note or add and remove its attachments.”
  • S10-R5a: “A note written by staff can be deleted by its author, or by a user who holds Delete for the kind of record it is on: 'Work Orders → Delete' for a work order or work order line note, 'Part Sales → Delete' for a part sale note, and 'Customers → Delete' for a customer or asset note.”
  • S10-R5a: “Notes written by customers in the portal and system notes have no menu and cannot be deleted from the app.”
  • S10-N1: “A user who is not a note's author is not offered edit on it (S10-R5). A user who is not the author and does not hold Delete for that kind of record is not offered delete (S10-R5a).”
